definitions.depth_km: the moon's position minus Jupiter's, projected on the line of sight (astrometric); positive = farther than Jupiter
definitions.disc: an ellipse of semi-axes a = asin(71492 km / distance) and a sqrt(1 - e^2 cos^2 D), e^2 = 1 - (66854/71492)^2, D the planetocentric latitude of the viewer; the moon's centre inside it
definitions.eclipse: at the moon's own light-time instant: the ray from the Sun's centre to the moon passes inside Jupiter's disc as seen from the Sun, Jupiter taken when the ray passed it, the moon beyond Jupiter
definitions.offsets: gnomonic east/north offsets of the moon's apparent geocentric direction (light-time, aberration, deflection: observe().apparent()) from Jupiter's centre (599), in the true equator and equinox of date
definitions.shadow_transit: at Jupiter's light-time instant: the ray from the Sun's centre past the moon (taken when the ray passed it) meets Jupiter's disc as seen from the Sun, the moon between the Sun and Jupiter
definitions.time: jd_tt is TT; jd_utc from Skyfield's UTC (builtin leap seconds)
definitions.transit_occultation: moon centre inside the Earth-view disc, in front of / behind Jupiter's centre
definitions.x_y: the offsets rotated so y points to the projection of Jupiter's IAU 2015 north pole (evaluated at Jupiter's light-time instant) and x is positive to the west, divided by Jupiter's apparent equatorial radius asin(71492 km / distance)

generator.description: Io, Europa, Ganymede and Callisto seen from the Earth's centre, relative to Jupiter's centre, from Skyfield with JPL's jup365 satellite ephemeris (excerpts) on DE440; and the starts and ends of their transits, occultations, eclipses and shadow transits over two 20-day windows of 2026.
generator.never_a_runtime_dependency: Development-time reference. CONVENTIONS section 11: never regenerate a fixture from Rust output.
